{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if any of these have revenue = 999999.99
qa_check = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders in loyal completed: {len(qa_check)}")

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Output results
print(f"Number of loyal completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}")

# Return the data for inspection
loyal_completed[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue', 'revenue_float', 'converted']].head(10)"}
